purpose: Mutable persistent location continuity. Create a named state file only when a location has state worth carrying across sessions/handoffs.
rules: Do not create this record for a prose-only location with no persistent mutable state.
Do not duplicate permanent description from the profile.
Track only state that can matter later: control, access, condition, security, function, durable presence or location-bound assets.
Use unknown or null rather than inventing a current condition.
